LanguageData.ST_RiteRaidDesc: The spirits of the ancient warriors test you! Survive this wave to prove your worth.
LanguageData.ST_RiteQuestDesc: 100 days of pain have forged you into warriors. The High Council has granted you the rank of 'Bekk'.\n\nBut one final test remains. A legendary Bat'leth has been hidden nearby, guarded by enemies of the Empire. Retrieve it to complete your Ascension! Qapla'!
